recentItems.title: In The End [Live in São Paulo] (Official Video) - Linkin Park
recentItems.description:
LINKIN PARK: UNSHATTER - In Theaters Now
Get tickets: http://unshattermovie.com

Our new live album, UNSHATTER Film Soundtrack (Live in São Paulo), is out now. 
https://lprk.co/unshattersoundtrack

UNSHATTER follows our journey through loss, resilience and creative reinvention. From studio sessions in 2022 to a sold out FROM ZERO album release show in São Paulo, this is the story of how we started over.

Directed by Joe Hahn.
